text:
eliya_k: Heads-up  we have a hybrid loop for candidate Priya Menon next Mon 08:30-12:00 PT. Shes asking for lactation room access, a low-sensory quiet room onsite (dimmable, no flashing lights), and permission to pair remotely from her own Mac for the coding exercise. Also asked about childcare reimbursement for travel day. Can ops confirm?

rachel_hr: Hiring lead here  loop is: quick intro (manager), tech pairing (remote), culture chat. Lactation access is required. Childcare reimbursement follows policy up to $150/day unless exception needed. Please add 2hr parking validation; shes driving from SF.

tom_facilities: We can reserve Lactation Room 2 and Quiet Room E. Quiet room will be set to low-sensory (dimmable lights, no fluorescent), signage "Low-sensory environment" on door. Do you need a whiteboard/projector in Quiet E or just table + monitor for remote pairing?

josh_it: If shes pairing from her own Mac we can provision a short-lived VPN token + Zoom breakout for low-latency screen-share. Candidate must sign a laptop waiver and disable iCloud/auto-sync for the session. Alternatively we can offer a loaner M1 imaged with Homebrew + Python3.10 + pairing image. Which does she prefer?

eliya_k: She prefers her own Mac. I will collect waiver and ask her to disable iCloud. Can you pre-create the VPN token and a temp creds file we can hand to her at front desk? Also please confirm lactation room keycode process.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Priya Menon  travel: San Francisco. Prefers USD reimbursement. Email: p.menon@example.com. Requested lactation accommodation and childcare reimbursement details.

tom_facilities: Lactation Room 2 booked 07:45-12:30 for setup/cleanup. Quiet Room E locked 07:30-12:30. I'll add a sanitized rocking chair + small fridge for expressed milk. Keycode for Lactation Room: `LAC-312` (front desk will give access after ID). Parking validation: code `PK-900` for 2 hours.

josh_it: VPN token and temp creds will be generated and printed for front desk pickup; token valid 08:15-12:30. We'll also whitelist internal mirrors only for the session. Waiver template: paste into calendar invite and have candidate sign on arrival. Note: if she later requests HSM or model artifacts on a loaner we need 24h lead time.

eliya_k: Agenda snippet for calendar please (short):
```
08:15  check-in + VPN token pickup
08:30  Intro / Hiring mgr (Rachel)
08:50  Remote pairing session (45m)
09:35  Break + buffer
09:45  Culture chat / benefits (30m)
10:15  Recruiter wrap + next steps
```

rachel_hr: Added agenda to invite and included childcare reimbursement policy link: https://intranet.company/expenses/childcare. Confirmed up to $150/day; receipts required. Also added a short note for front desk: "Ask for Priya - lactation access".

tom_facilities: Catering: single boxed breakfast (dairy-free option) + bottled water. We'll place "Quiet room in use" sign and ask security to escort candidate to Quiet E on arrival.

josh_it: Tiny security note: if candidate uses own Mac, screen-record permissions may block screen-share. Please have them enable system screen recording for Zoom beforehand; waiver will remind them. We'll sanitize any loaner if needed.

eliya_k: I'll send the invite after I confirm waiver signed and VPN token ready. Also will confirm childcare reimbursement amount with candidate. Thanks all. :pray:

recruiter_bot: (automated) Calendar invite created and sent to p.menon@example.com, Rachel, Tom, Josh, Eliya. Invite ID: 1905002468-prmn. Closing loop unless changes.
